scope: Evaluation of existing frozen matrices only; no correction, tuning, or method selection is permitted.

provenance.analysis_commit: codex/permutation-drift-rerun; recorded final code commit before publication

common_processing.feature_panel: Within each dataset, the exact intersection of feature identifiers across all nine frozen method matrices, in raw-matrix order; no method-specific feature removal.
common_processing.sample_panel: Within each dataset, the exact intersection of correction-unit identifiers across all nine frozen matrices and frozen metadata, in raw-matrix order.
common_processing.weighted_pc_label: Variance-weighted mean R-squared across principal components 1-5

simulation.bootstrap: Resample the completed frozen seeds with replacement and preserve method pairing within seed.
simulation.permutation: Not applicable because truth recovery is observed directly.

waveica.endpoint: deposited biological_group with neutral labels group_0 and group_1
waveica.bootstrap: Resample study samples within batch-by-group strata; use identical draws for every method and recompute each metric.
waveica.permutation: Permute group labels among study samples within batch while preserving group counts.
waveica.association_model: Two-group feature model on log1p intensities with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR.
waveica.leave_one_batch_out: Estimate group_1-minus-group_0 log1p effects in training batches and independently in the held-out batch.

mtbls79.bootstrap: Resample biological identities within class and carry all repeated injections of an identity together.
mtbls79.permutation: Permute class labels at biological-identity level; repeated injections retain the assigned label.
mtbls79.association_model: Average log1p repeated injections by biological identity, then fit a two-group feature model with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR.
mtbls79.leave_one_batch_out: Within each fold, average at most one profile per biological identity and estimate cow-minus-sheep effects independently in training and held-out batches.

sacurine.bootstrap: Resample study samples within batch and use identical draws for all methods.
sacurine.permutation: Freedman-Lane residual permutation within batch for each focal covariate, with the other biological covariates and sampling factor retained as nuisance terms.
sacurine.association_model: Osmolality-normalized intensities; multivariable log1p feature model containing standardized age, standardized BMI, deposited gender, and sampling factor.
sacurine.leave_one_batch_out: Two-batch effect replication where the focal covariate is estimable in both training and held-out samples.

batchcorr_set1.bootstrap: Cluster bootstrap accessions and carry every replicate injection together.
batchcorr_set1.permutation: Not applicable to the primary replicate-preservation endpoints.
batchcorr_set1.matching: Each study profile queries study profiles in a different batch; rank candidate accessions by Pearson similarity and exclude the query profile.

clinical_fiams.bootstrap: Cluster bootstrap anonymized biological samples and carry all pair-collapsed correction units together.
clinical_fiams.permutation: Not applicable to the primary replicate-preservation endpoints.
clinical_fiams.matching: Each clinical profile queries clinical profiles on a different plate; rank candidate biological samples by Pearson similarity. Identifiers are hashed in public derivative output.
